utv.uk.description: Join chef Ainsley Harriott as he immerses himself in the food, culture and people of the Bahamas while offering an authentic look at Bahamian life and flavour - in this episode, it's all things sweet as Ainsley dives into honey, sugarcane, and the island's beloved guava duff while also meeting the makers keeping old-school treats alive at Mortimer's Candies and creating coconut-lime creams with a crunchy Bahamian twist. (Reality) - 2026

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: Agronomist Ben arrives to check on the farm's oats and maize, but before getting down to business, Max has an important call to make to Spider-Man. Once his superhero duties are complete, attention turns to the crops and how they are progressing. Meanwhile, Liz and Kelvin enjoy an unusual day date with a visit to local beekeepers. Hoping to bring bees to the farm, they discover what it takes to care for a colony and learn there is plenty to consider before taking the plunge. There is also a farewell as bull Ezra's time on the farm comes to an end. Kelvin takes him to market in the hope of finding him a new home, marking another change among the farm's animals. Then it is all hands on deck for the Royal Cheshire Show. Liz and Kelvin pack enough farm produce to fill a huge marquee, along with the butcher's fridge to keep their Milo sausages chilled. With everything ready, they step into the world of trading and face a busy day behind the counter. (Reality) - 2023

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure - Orkney
utv.uk.description: James' adventure begins on the Orkney Islands, a place he's never been to and is excited to explore - he's also joined by top Scottish chef and good friend Nick Nairn for the journey. James gets straight to it and shops for hand-dived scallops before setting up his mobile kitchen in Stromness Harbour to make BBQ scallops with black pudding, apple and hazelnut butter - he then takes to the skies to visit North Ronaldsay, where the people are outnumbered by sheep, and cooks up some lamb chops. James's Orkney odyssey ends with a boat trip to catch its famous brown crab so he can rustle up a gorgeous Orkney crab pasta. (Documentary, Reality) - 2019

utv.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
utv.uk.description: James is joined by actress Shelley Conn, who is starring in ITV1's Adultery. Comedian and travel writer Dom Joly is also in the house, with chefs Sally Abe and Glynn Purnell. [S. (Reality, Talk) - 2017

utv.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm this time are Chris McCausland, Sort Your Life Out's Dilly Carter and Rachael Stirling. Plus, the second instalment of the Wildlife Sanctuary in the making, and the Urban Birder, David Lindo, gets up and close with pelicans. Meanwhile, Ian Burrell has a good measure of rum hot toddies.

utv.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
utv.uk.description: The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. With their home range on display and Milo's sausages on the menu, can they win over the crowds across two busy days? With 3,000 sausages to sell, will Milo bring home some pocket money? Kelvin, meanwhile, misses having his cattle alongside him. A visit to the cattle sheds gives him the chance to admire this year's entries and learn more about dairy cows. For Marnie and her lamb Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. After plenty of practice, first-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece. With Hope's welfare the priority, can they get her fit and ready for the ring, giving Marnie the chance to put all her hard work into practice. (Reality) - 2023

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 Open Ocean Wildlife in the open oceans far beyond the sight of land, from giant blue whales to tiny drifting crabs. The programme explores how the sea is shaped by powerful currents that flow across the globe like invisible rivers. Among the areas visited are the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt, one of the largest floating ecosystems on the planet.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 Hamza's Lowlands: Moffat Hills Hamza Yassin heads to a secret location in Scotland's Southern Uplands to join a dedicated team on an exciting mission to protect the peregrine falcon. Getting up close to three chicks, he discovers how DNA sampling is helping tackle the theft of these remarkable birds. Along the way, the programme revisits memorable Countryfile wildlife encounters.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S46 E9 Roundhay Park, Leeds 2 Fiona Bruce presents the show from Roundhay Park, Leeds, where highlights include a rare Alfred Wallis painting, an unusual Fairyland Lustre bowl, and a cap made from celebrated racehorse Red Rum's hair. Fiona also explores the local history of high street chain Marks and Spencer when she sees some relics from the archives, whilst Joanna Hardy challenges her to spot the difference between a real diamond and a fake.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E16 Week 8 Results Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present as the two lowest-scoring couples go head to head in the dance-off, fighting for a place at Blackpool. Plus, the professionals show the celebrities how it's done with a group routine.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Blue Planet III
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 Seasonal Seas The wildlife in the seasonal seas in the temperate bands between the freezing poles and the warm tropics, where changing conditions over the course of the year push animals to be resourceful and adaptable. In the winter, storms at sea whip up immense waves that can travel for thousands of miles building to 30 metres height, while in the summer, temperatures can rise by 50 degrees Celsius in a matter of weeks.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Summer
eden.uk.plus1.description: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Autumn
eden.uk.plus1.description: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic `whale spa'. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - Winter
eden.uk.plus1.description: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Frozen Planet - The Last Frontier
eden.uk.plus1.description: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dogan survive by herding reindeer. (Documentary, Nature) - 2011

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Manhattan Island
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael begins his American adventure on Manhattan Island. Starting at New York's Grand Central Terminal, he boards the Manhattan subway system, the busiest rail transit system in the US. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Brooklyn to Montauk
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning in Brooklyn, Michael hears the moving story behind the construction of the world's first steel suspension bridge high above the East River. Below ground, he investigates the arrival of New York City's first subway and the dangers faced by the men who built it: the `sandhogs'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - New York City to Albany
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael follows America's iconic River Hudson north through New York State. Beginning at New York City's Penn Station, Michael rides the national rail carrier service, Amtrak. He hears from Amtrak's police chief how railroad policing began to tackle the nation's most notorious train robbers, among them Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great American Railroad Journeys - Schenectady to Niagara Falls
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo braves the awesome power and drenching spray of Niagara Falls in the `Maid of the Mist' to share what artists, daredevils and millions of tourists have billed as one of the most spectacular experiences on the planet. (Documentary, Travel) - 2016

eden.uk.plus1.title: Abandoned Engineering - The Valkyrie Assassin
eden.uk.plus1.description: The underground base with the power to destroy a nation, the site linked with an attempt to kill a dictator, and an ancient world discovered in the American wilderness. (Documentary, News, Technology) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys - South Coast Part 3
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo arrives in Southampton, a large port city that is home to many maritime and scientific agencies, such as the National Oceanography Centre. (Documentary, Travel)

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E20 New York The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles.

itv1anglia.uk.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar.

England have won all six of the previous meetings between the nations, including a comfortable 59-14 victory here when the sides last faced each other two years ago, and they will expect to maintain that 100 per cent record today. With commentary by Nick Mullins and David Flatman, analysis from Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi, and reports by Topsy Ojo.

It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. itvcentral.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Japan
itvcentral.uk.description: Eddie Jones returns to the Allianz Stadium as his Japan side take on England in the Nations Championship. Borthwick's England team are still a work in progress - but will be aiming for a repeat performance of their last outing against Japan in November 2024. (Rugby)

It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke.

stvnorth.uk.title: Inside the Asylum Camp
stvnorth.uk.description: Mass accommodation sites are central to the Government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels and this undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp in East Sussex now housing asylum seekers. The programme investigates conditions inside the site, finding how systemically poor welfare checks are having serious consequences, and also examines the local community's response to asylum seekers being housed in the town.

amc.us.title: Die Hard 2
amc.us.description: A year after his heroics in L.A., detective John McClane (Bruce Willis) is mixed up in another terrorist plot, this time at Washington Dulles International Airport, where he is waiting for his wife (Bonnie Bedelia). That same night, South American politico and drug profiteer Ramon Esperanza (Franco Nero) is arriving in U.S. custody. McClane takes action when a treasonous ex-colonel (William Sadler) seizes control of the airport, threatening to crash every inbound flight unless Esperanza is freed. (Action, Thriller) - 1990

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 3 -- Parabellum
amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. Now stuck with a $14 million bounty on his head, Wick must fight his way through the streets of New York as he becomes the target of the world's most ruthless killers. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

But when Calogero falls for his African-American classmate, Jane, the repercussions threaten the entire neighborhood. (Crime drama) - 1993

amc.us.title: Rudy
amc.us.description: Rudy Ruettiger (Sean Astin) wants to play football at the University of Notre Dame, but has neither the money for tuition nor the grades to qualify for a scholarship. Rudy redoubles his efforts to get out of the steel mill where his father works when his best friend (Christopher Reed) dies in an accident there. Overcoming his dyslexia thanks to his friend and tutor, D-Bob (Jon Favreau), Rudy gains admission to Notre Dame and begins to fight his way onto the school's fabled football team. (Drama) - 1993

amc.us.title: Star Wars: A New Hope
amc.us.description: The Imperial Forces -- under orders from cruel Darth Vader (David Prowse) -- hold Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) hostage, in their efforts to quell the rebellion against the Galactic Empire. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) and Han Solo (Harrison Ford), captain of the Millennium Falcon, work together with the companionable droid duo R2-D2 (Kenny Baker) and C-3PO (Anthony Daniels) to rescue the beautiful princess, help the Rebel Alliance, and restore freedom and justice to the Galaxy. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1977

amc.us.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
amc.us.description: The adventure continues in this "Star Wars" sequel. Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill), Han Solo (Harrison Ford), Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) and Chewbacca (Peter Mayhew) face attack by the Imperial forces and its AT-AT walkers on the ice planet Hoth. While Han and Leia escape in the Millennium Falcon, Luke travels to Dagobah in search of Yoda. Only with the Jedi master's help will Luke survive when the dark side of the Force beckons him into the ultimate duel with Darth Vader (David Prowse). (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1980

amc.us.title: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
amc.us.description: Luke Skywalker (Mark Hamill) battles horrible Jabba the Hutt and cruel Darth Vader to save his comrades in the Rebel Alliance and triumph over the Galactic Empire. Han Solo (Harrison Ford) and Princess Leia (Carrie Fisher) reaffirm their love and team with Chewbacca, Lando Calrissian (Billy Dee Williams), the Ewoks and the androids C-3PO and R2-D2 to aid in the disruption of the Dark Side and the defeat of the evil emperor. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1983

babytv.uk.description: Hop on a bike with Charlie and Number Six through the magical flower lane to find a cure for Charlie's sneezes.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Blue triangle and Orange triangle's ball gets stuck in a tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Can you stand on your head? Come see the shapes compete who can stand on their head the longest.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Yellow rectangle doesn't want to be late for the shapes' party. But grey rectangle is taking his time drinking tea.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny have fun pretending to be cows, playing the music game and hide and seek.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny build a tall tower together, play the music game and "what's hiding beneath the handkerchief.

babytv.uk.title: Good-Morning Stretch
babytv.uk.description: Teeny and Tiny have fun singing together, playing with puppets and "which is the odd one out".

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Baby Hippo is learning how to walk. On his way he meets a flying butterfly, a jumping frog and a crawling snail.

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: A baby chick! Help find the missing flower piece! What item is missing to complete the 3-of-a-kind game? A kettle!

babytv.uk.title: Hippa Hippa Hey
babytv.uk.description: Locks! Find the missing part to complete the banana. What's hiding in the hidden picture game? A sand bucket and shovel!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader a hat, a magic wand, a broom and a cauldron. Let's be witches!

babytv.uk.title: Choopies
babytv.uk.description: The Choopies bring their scout leader objects they have managed to collect. Together they build something fun they all can play with!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little bear doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw his plastic bottle. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: The elephants play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little giraffe doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw her cardboard tube. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal neighs! Can you guess which vegetable is long and orange?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal moos! Can you guess which vegetable is round and red?

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops have sailed to the island and crossed the waterfall. Now they need to solve a puzzle to get to the treasure!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail as he meets a lovely cricket at night! Discover how he makes that sound by rubbing his wings!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a frog in the pond! Splash along and help Mr. Snail solve frog's riddles! Who lives in the water and on land and blows balloons?

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry are relaxing on the ship when a toucan starts throwing nuts at them but they know how to turn any situation into something fun.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: What have you got there, Pix? It's a box full of musical instruments. What a fantastic day to play music. Let's see how to play each instrument.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Kaa and Baloo are complete opposites but they still manage to be the best of friends. Baloo looks a big bear hug but Kaa doesn't like to be touched.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A comb arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused comb discover its true use? S2 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency
babytv.uk.description: A pinwheel arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused pinwheel discover its true use? S3 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: "One, two, buckle my shoe; Three, four, shut the door?" Counting is the best! Let's join Charlie & the Numbers.

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Hal turns to Mikey when his bike light stops working. Mikey has a few creative ideas but they don't all go according to plan. Will he be able to help?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Bunny, Petite, Johnny and Hal plan a surprise party for Mikey's birthday. Will they be able to organize the party without Mikey noticing?

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Hal has a problem remembering where he left his tricycle. Will Mikey be able to find a solution for forgetful Hal?

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become painters! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles paints! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become fairies! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a magic wand and panpipes!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Mice Builders are enthusiastically devoted to building their new house. When a messenger arrives with a package, they put down their tools and attempt to guess what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they turn their colouring boxes into rattles and dance with them at the carnival!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they pair up socks and use them as make-believe geese having fun playing with each other!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Five little monkeys jumping on the bed! Can you guess what happens? One falls off and bumps his head! Somebody call the doctor!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel invites his friends to come play with him in his new tree house.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Rabbit has received a package. Everyone is curious to know what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant has a brand new hat that she loves, but the wind blew it right off her head!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are having fun sailing on a raft! What's the round and white reflection in the water?

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy are covered with paint after painting! It's time for a bath! Ducky is afraid to shampoo his hair!

babytv.uk.title: Bath Tubbies
babytv.uk.description: Ducky, Ellie and Froggy want to take a bath but it's empty! Cloud comes to fill it up with rain but the water disappears!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they use a cardboard box as a rocket ship! Set out on an exciting adventure into outer space!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they play in a sandbox! Sail on a river through magical castles and into the sea!

babytv.uk.title: Look What I Found
babytv.uk.description: The wind is blowing and the magazine flies away! Join the friends as they take off on paper that turns into a flying carpet and a plane!

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Tickles can't stop sneezing! His friends bring him a whistle in case he needs help.

babytv.uk.title: The Cuddlies
babytv.uk.description: Dodo can't seem to stay awake for the midnight surprise. Join his friends as they fall asleep while trying to keep him up!

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: The giraffes play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Little boy doesn't know in which recylcing bin to throw his glass lightbulb. The animals have a great time playing their instruments in music class.

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the City
babytv.uk.description: Peter and little bear play soccer in the park when their ball gets stuck in the tree. How will they get it down?

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal makes a moo sound! Can you guess which vegetable is brown and strange? S1 Ep33

babytv.uk.title: Little Lola Visits the Farm
babytv.uk.description: Join Lola and have fun on the farm as she discovers which animal makes a quack sound! Can you guess which vegetable is round?

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops go on an adventure to find the treasure. On the way they play games and solve puzzles.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a beaver and his son by the lake! Come watch them cut down a tree with their teeth!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a magical chameleon! At first he's green and then he's brown!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: What's more fun than eating cakes and breads? Eating them with your favorite BabyTV characters - Hungry Henry, Billy and Bambam, Draco and Oliver!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam have fun watching the bears make food together. Sometimes things don't go quite as expected but that's part of the fun.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Monkey is gathering delicious fruit in his leaf and he doesn't want to share any with Pix and Leo. But, oh no! There is a hole in Monkey's leaf.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli, Leela and Gray accidently kick their ball into a spooky cave. Mowgli gets quite a fright when trying to get the ball back.

babytv.uk.title: Zeina's Detective Agency

babytv.uk.description: A kite arrives at Zeina's doorstep, forgetting what it is used for. Can Zeina and Roy help the confused kite discover its true use? S3 Ep7

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Petite wants to open a lemonade stand, but the lemons keep falling off her bike. Mikey offer to help with trays and even an entire kitchen. S1 Ep14

babytv.uk.title: Mike's Bikes
babytv.uk.description: Bunny wants to ride her bike with a cape, but her cape keeps getting stuck in the bike chain. Will Mikey be able to help? S1 Ep5

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mountaineers! Climb the high mountain, paint fluffy clouds and tickle the sky way up high! S1 Ep17

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they use building blocks and sticks to create a wonderful game of limbo! So how low can you go? S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they use a chalkstone to draw arrows and signs and play follow me!

babytv.uk.description: Join the friends as they float inside the bubbles and slide down a colourful rainbow made of bubbles!

babytv.uk.description: The friends have fun sweeping with a broom! Come along as the broom turns into a happy horse!

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
cinemax.us.description: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Solace
cinemax.us.description: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: The Rover
cinemax.us.description: In the near future, mankind's greed and excesses have pushed civilization to the breaking point. Society is in decline, and the rule of law has disintegrated. Hardened drifter Eric (Guy Pearce) wanders across this dangerous and desolate landscape. When thieves steal Eric's car -- and only remaining possession -- they leave behind Rey (Robert Pattinson), a wounded comrade. Eric forces Rey to help him hunt down the gang in an unrelenting quest to take back the one thing that matters to him. (Drama, Thriller) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Will Rodman, a scientist in San Francisco, is experimenting with a drug that he hopes will cure his father's Alzheimer's disease. After his work is deemed a failure, Will becomes the guardian of Caesar, an infant chimp who was exposed in utero to Will's drug. Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

cinemax.us.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
cinemax.us.description: Many years after the reign of Caesar, a young ape goes on a journey that will lead him to question everything he's been taught about the past and make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (Historical drama, LGBTQ, Drama) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Hail Satan?
cinemax.us.description: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul. (Documentary) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Apparition
cinemax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemax.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: The Judge
cinemax.us.description: Hank Palmer (Robert Downey Jr.), a brilliant but shady attorney, returns to his Indiana hometown after learning that his mother has passed away. His arrival triggers renewed tension between himself and his father, Judge Joseph Palmer (Robert Duvall), who makes no secret of his disapproval of Hank's morally ambiguous career. As the lawyer prepares to depart, his father is arrested for a hit-and-run death. Hank takes on his father's defense, despite the objections of the resentful old man. (Drama) - 2014

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Alto Knights
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the 1950s, notorious New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the city streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 2025-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Aniara
cinemaxaction.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2018-09-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxaction.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled science teacher can prevent the end of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-09-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
cinemaxaction.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run and do the harder job of staying put. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2019-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hangover Part II
cinemaxaction.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-04-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Return of Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: Okumura witnesses a huge monster during a storm. Biologist Hayashida hears Okumura's story from Toto Nippo reporter Maki and concludes that Godzilla, who was buried 30 years ago, has come back to life. Godzilla then appears in Tokyo Bay. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1984-12-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Epic
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Animation, Children) - 2013-05-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Flash
cinemaxaction.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. disneyxd.us.title: DuckTales
disneyxd.us.description: Scrooge McDuck is back in this reboot of the late-'80s animated series. He gains guardianship of grandnephews Huey, Dewey and Louie when Donald Duck reluctantly takes them to McDuck Manor, the wonder of which enthralls the mischievous triplets. While living with their trillionaire relative, the boys learn long-held family secrets and unleash symbolic artifacts from Scrooge's past. The threesome's antics send the family on a number of adventures, which include Webby Vanderquack, the granddaughter of Scrooge's housekeeper, Mrs. Beakley. The show's animation style is inspired by the classic comic designs of animator Carl Barks. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017-08-11

Barney is excited to finally have his own robot -- until his new toy starts to hilariously malfunction, drawing the attention of a shady executive who wants to protect his company's stock price at all costs. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2021

freeform.us.title: Oliver & Company
freeform.us.description: In this animated update of the classic Oliver Twist tale, Oliver (Joey Lawrence) is an orphaned kitten taken in by a gang of thieving dogs, led by cavalier canine Dodger (Billy Joel) and owned by down-and-out pickpocket Fagin (Dom DeLuise). While pulling a job in the streets of New York City, Oliver winds up being adopted by a rich girl, Jenny (Natalie Gregory), and landing on easy street. But through a series of events, a loan shark threatens the peaceful new arrangement. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1988

freeform.us.title: The Aristocats
freeform.us.description: When a retired opera singer leaves her inheritance to her cat, Duchess (Eva Gabor), and three kittens, the woman's butler drugs the cats and abandons them in the countryside in order to inherit the fortune himself. Lost in unfamiliar territory, Duchess and the kittens meet Thomas O'Malley (Phil Harris), an alley cat willing to help them return to their home in Paris. They meet several kooky characters along the way, including two English geese and an alley cat jazz band. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 1970

freeform.us.title: Pocahontas
freeform.us.description: This is the Disney animated tale of the romance between a young American Indian woman named Pocahontas (Irene Bedard) and Capt. John Smith (Mel Gibson), who journeyed to the New World with other settlers to begin fresh lives. Her powerful father, Chief Powhatan, disapproves of their relationship and wants her to marry a native warrior. Meanwhile, Smith's fellow Englishmen hope to rob the Native Americans of their gold. Can Pocahontas' love for Smith save the day? (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1995

freeform.us.title: The Emperor's New Groove
freeform.us.description: Arrogant young Emperor Kuzco is transformed into a llama by his power-hungry advisor -- the devious diva Yzma. Stranded in the jungle, Kuzco's only chance to get back home and reclaim the high life rests with a good-hearted peasant named Pacha. Together, they must return Kuzco to the throne before Yzma tracks them down and finishes him off. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2000

freeform.us.title: The Princess and the Frog
freeform.us.description: Hardworking and ambitious, Tiana dreams of one day opening the finest restaurant in New Orleans. Her dream takes a slight detour when she meets Prince Naveen, who has been turned into an amphibian by evil Dr. Facilier. Mistaking her for a princess and hoping to break the spell, Naveen plants a kiss on poor Tiana, thereby turning her into a frog as well. The pair hop along on an adventure through the bayous to seek the help of a voodoo priestess. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Musical) - 2009

freeform.us.title: Moana
freeform.us.description: An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity. (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure) - 2016

freeform.us.title: Lilo & Stitch
freeform.us.description: A tale of a young girl's close encounter with the galaxy's most wanted extraterrestrial. Lilo is a lonely Hawaiian girl who adopts a small ugly "dog," whom she names Stitch. Stitch would be the perfect pet if he weren't in reality a genetic experiment who has escaped from an alien planet and crash-landed on Earth. Through her love, faith and unwavering belief in ohana, the Hawaiian concept of family, Lilo helps unlock Stitch's heart and gives him the ability to care for someone else. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2002

freeform.us.title: The Jungle Book
freeform.us.description: In this classic Walt Disney animation based on Rudyard Kipling's book, Mowgli, an abandoned child raised by wolves, has his peaceful existence threatened by the return of the man-eating tiger Shere Khan. Facing certain death, Mowgli must overcome his reluctance to leave his wolf family and return to the "man village." But he is not alone on his quest: Aided by Bagheera the panther, and later by the carefree bear Baloo, he braves the jungle's many perils. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1967

freeform.us.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch
freeform.us.description: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbors in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

freeform.us.title: Robin Hood
freeform.us.description: An amiable rooster called Alan-a-Dale (Roger Miller) tells stories and sings songs of the heroic Robin Hood (Brian Bedford) and his trusty sidekick, Little John (Phil Harris), in this animated animal-themed adaptation of the legendary story. When evil Prince John (Peter Ustinov) deputizes the Sheriff of Nottingham (Pat Buttram) to collect unreasonable taxes from the animals of Sherwood Forest, Robin, Little John and the other merry men wage a lighthearted battle against their evil foes. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1973

freeform.us.title: Peter Pan
freeform.us.description: In this Disney animated film, Wendy and her two brothers are amazed when a magical boy named Peter Pan flies into their bedroom, supposedly in pursuit of his rebellious shadow. He and his fairy friend, Tinker Bell, come from a far-off place called Neverland, where children stay perpetually young. Enchanted, the kids follow him back. But when Pan's nemesis, the pirate Captain Hook, causes trouble, the kids begin to miss their old life. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1953

freeform.us.title: Pinocchio
freeform.us.description: When the woodworker Geppetto (Christian Rub) sees a falling star, he wishes that the puppet he just finished, Pinocchio (Dickie Jones), could become a real boy. In the night, the Blue Fairy (Evelyn Venable) grants Geppetto's wish and asks Jiminy Cricket (Cliff Edwards) to serve as the wooden boy's conscience. But the naive and trusting Pinocchio falls into the clutches of the wicked Honest John (Walter Catlett), who leads him astray to the sinful Pleasure Island. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1940

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause
freeform.us.description: Divorced dad Scott (Tim Allen) has custody of his son (Eric Lloyd) on Christmas Eve. After he accidentally kills a man in a Santa suit, they are magically transported to the North Pole, where an elf explains that Scott must take Santa's place before the next Christmas arrives. Scott thinks he's dreaming, but over the next several months he gains weight and grows an inexplicably white beard. Maybe that night at the North Pole wasn't a dream after all -- and maybe Scott has a lot of work to do. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1994

freeformwest.us.title: Mary Poppins Returns
freeformwest.us.description: Now an adult with three children, bank teller Michael Banks learns that his house will be repossessed in five days unless he can pay back a loan. His only hope is to find a missing certificate that shows proof of valuable shares that his father left him years earlier. Just as all seems lost, Michael and his sister receive the surprise of a lifetime when Mary Poppins -- the beloved nanny from their childhood -- arrives to save the day and take the Banks family on a magical, fun-filled adventure. (Children, Musical, Fantasy, Adventure, Animated) - 2018

freeformwest.us.title: Home Alone

After the McCallisters mistakenly leave for the airport without Kevin, he awakens to an empty house and assumes his wish to have no family has come true. But his excitement sours when he realizes that two con men plan to rob the McCallister residence, and that he alone must protect the family home. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1990

freeformwest.us.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
freeformwest.us.description: After snarky youth Kevin McCallister loses track of his father at the airport, he mistakenly gets on a plane headed for New York City -- while the rest of the McCallisters fly to Florida. gsn.us.title: Cash Cab
gsn.us.description: In this offbeat game show, players picked up in the Cash Cab have to answer trivia questions with mounting cash values before they reach their destination in order to win. If a player answers incorrectly three times, he is kicked out of the cab without any money. Help options include a Mobile Shout-Out (phone call) and Street Shout-Out (asking a stranger on the street). Once the player reaches his destination, he can leave the cab with his winnings, if any, or risk them on a more difficult question. A correct final answer doubles his winnings; an incorrect answer means he leaves the cab with no money at all. Comic Ben Bailey takes the cab's wheel as host. (Game show, Reality, Show) - 2005-12-05

gsn.us.description: Contestants must stand their ground on a massive, interactive LED game floor of squares, each representing a different trivia category. The winner takes over the loser's square, gaining valuable ground as they expand their territory, while the loser exits the game. mgmplushits.us.description: Wealthy Moroccan sheik Ishak (Ferdinand Mayne), believing himself to be the true owner, dispatches his henchmen to steal a champion Arabian stallion, the Black, from its young caretaker, Alec Ramsay (Kelly Reno). Determined to recover the horse, Alec follows the sheik back to Morocco, where his pleas for the stallion's return fall on deaf ears. When Alec learns that Ishak plans to enter the Black in an upcoming race, he settles for training the horse's new jockey -- for the time being. (Children, Adventure) - 1983

mgmplushits.us.title: Legally Blonde
mgmplushits.us.description: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) has it all. She wants nothing more than to be Mrs. Warner Huntington III. But there is one thing stopping him (Matthew Davis) from proposing: She is too blond. Elle rallies all of her resources and gets into Harvard, determined to win him back. (Comedy) - 2001

mgmplushits.us.title: Legally Blonde 2: Red, White & Blonde
mgmplushits.us.description: Elle Woods (Reese Witherspoon) journeys to Washington, D.C., to have her say about animal rights, but is ignored by every politician she encounters and quickly learns that the White House can be even tougher to navigate than the Ivy League. Finally, Elle makes the acquaintance of sympathetic Rep. Victoria Rudd (Sally Field), who helps the young lawyer get her foot in the door of Congress. Unfortunately, Elle still has to convince the entire legislature to hear her out. (Comedy) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: In Too Deep
mgmplushits.us.description: Drug lord Dwayne Gittens (LL Cool J) rules Cincinnati with an iron fist. No wonder he's known as God on the streets. Determined to break Gittens' stranglehold on the city is undercover cop Jeffrey Cole (Omar Epps). Supporting him in the difficult task ahead is his girlfriend (Nia Long) and his tough-as-nails commander (Stanley Tucci). But as Cole takes on an assumed identity to penetrate Gittens' criminal empire, he makes a disturbing discovery -- he kind of likes being a gangster. (Crime drama) - 1999

mgmplushits.us.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
mgmplushits.us.description: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1996

mgmplushits.us.title: Worldbreaker
mgmplushits.us.description: A father hides his daughter on an island to keep her safe while he equips her for survival and the battles ahead. (Action, Science fiction, Drama) - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Mystic Pizza
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: For sexy Daisy Araujo, her sensible sister Kat and their wisecracking friend Jojo, the summer after high school is a summer they can never forget. Slinging pizza at a local restaurant, the three girls share their hopes, dreams and plans for escaping their small town. (Romantic comedy) - 1988

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Baby Boom
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: J.C. Wiatt is a New York City businesswoman who is married to her job and has a relationship with Steven, a successful investment broker. J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a relative suddenly dies and makes her the caretaker of a baby girl. Soon, the baby's arrival causes J.C. to lose first Steven, and then her job. She moves to Vermont and embarks on a series of life-changing events. But when offered the opportunity, will she return to her corporate ways? (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The First Wives Club
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. When the three discover the reason for their friend's suicide, they realize that all of their ex-husbands have taken them for granted -- and deciding it's time for revenge, they make a pact to get back at their exes. (Comedy) - 1996

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Book Club
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Four friends' lives are turned upside down when their book club tackles the infamous "50 Shades of Grey." From discovering new romance to rekindling old flames, they inspire each other to make their next chapter the best chapter. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The American President
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: With the end of his first term in sight, widowed U.S. President Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas) knows that overwhelming public support will guarantee his re-election. But when he falls in love with lobbyist Sydney Ellen Wade (Annette Bening), Shepherd's supporters question the relationship, and his approval ratings drop. As a rival presidential candidate goes on the attack, Shepherd must choose between his political career and his love for Sydney. (Romance, Comedy drama) - 1995

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Chaplin
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charles Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography) - 1992

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Unseen

Using a phone, Sam becomes Emily's only chance for survival as she guides the terrified woman through a video call. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Fluke
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Workaholic Thomas P. Johnson (Matthew Modine) has achieved professional success at the expense of his family life, having neglected his wife, Carol (Nancy Travis), and son, Brian (Max Pomeranc). After Johnson wrecks his car in a dangerous street race with co-worker Jeff Newman (Eric Stoltz), he finds himself watching his own funeral. Returning to Earth as a dog, Johnson finds his family and struggles to have a positive influence on their lives -- in spite of his canine form. (Children, Drama) - 1995

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Overboard
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's hired to clean a luxury yacht that belongs to Leonardo -- a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy. After unjustly firing Kate, Leonardo falls off the boat and wakes up with no memory of who he is. To get payback, Kate shows up at the hospital and convinces the confused amnesiac that they're married. As Leonardo tries to get used to manual labor and his new family, Kate starts to wonder how long she can keep fooling her fake husband. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: In the near future, "The Running Man" is the top-rated show on television, a deadly competition where contestants must survive 30 days while being hunted by professional assassins. Desperate for money to save his sick daughter, Ben Richards is convinced by the show's ruthless producer to enter the game as a last resort. Ratings soon skyrocket as Ben's defiance, instincts and grit turn him into an unexpected fan favorite, as well as a threat to the entire system. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2025

Joe team take on Destro (Christopher Eccleston), a corrupt arms dealer, and fight the growing threat of the mysterious Cobra organization. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009

Cotrona, Lee Byung-hun) face a two-fold threat. motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys race to be the first ever to drop a Hellcat motor in their 1979 International Scout and fulfill hot-rodder Richard's quest to fetch a world record for the most expensive ever sold; Richard urges a friend to buy a 1963 Stingray. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-07-22

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Vintage Payday
motortrend.us.description: Richard races toward a vintage payday by restoring his '37 Buick Racer back to its Indy 500 roots; the guys buy a one-owner '77 Blazer that could fetch them double their money; a surprise birthday gift has Richard feeling nostalgic. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-26

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - No Second Chances
motortrend.us.description: The Monkeys put the pedal to the metal in their final attempt to finish the 1972 Buick Riviera super-build in time for SEMA; the team's integrity is on the line, and $300,000 has been invested, so failure is not an option. (Reality, Auto) - 2019-09-23

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Race Against Time
motortrend.us.description: Richard Rawlings and his crew of Monkeys race to finish a replica 1937 Buick Indy Racer for a deep-pocket client; the 1975 Datsun 280 Z draws a buyer, sending Richard racing to the bank. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-20

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Super Troupe Jeep
motortrend.us.description: Gas Monkey teams up with the Gary Sinise Foundation to build a custom '81 Jeep CJ7 as a throwback tribute to the soldiers for Veterans Day; an original '68 Chevelle has Richard seeing green but only if he can part with his California dream. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-03-30

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Wranglin' World Records
motortrend.us.description: The team works on a 2018 Jeep Wrangler, the second Jeep they renew for Veterans Day; Richards makes a deal for a 1955 Crown Vic. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-19

motortrend.us.title: Fast N' Loud - Quick-Flippin' a Caddy
motortrend.us.description: Richard pays big bucks hoping to use a '63 Cadillac for a quick flip project; the guys do a bang-up job on a budget, but Jason goes rogue and risks tanking the whole thing. (Reality, Auto) - 2020-04-27

motortrend.us.description: The Garage Squad needs some divine intervention to get this pastor's hulk of a '74 Bronco out of garage hell. (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2018-08-29

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - Grandma Loves Her Nova
motortrend.us.description: This Nova has been in the family for three generations and seen more that its share of rough patches; now the grandson is on a mission with the Garage Squad to bring it back to glory for Grandma. (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2018-10-03

motortrend.us.title: Garage Squad - 56 Ford Truck
motortrend.us.description: After years sitting in storage in a corn crib a 1956 Ford Truck gets some TLC; does the old girl have enough life left, to get her back out on the road? (Reality, How-to, Auto) - 2016-09-14

motortrend.us.title: My Classic Car - Monkeemobile and Greased Lightning
motortrend.us.description: My Classic Car captures America's love affair with the automobile! Dennis Gage, the handlebar mustachioed host, takes you along for the ride and keeps it entertaining with his unique perspective and enthusiasm for all things automotive. (Auto) - 2026-05-16

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - F-Rod Begins and Cougar Ends!
motortrend.us.description: David and Steve encounter further issues with the Bang-Shifting Cougar. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-03-04

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - It's Alive: The F-Rod Lives!
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich get the F-Rod 1931 Model A fired up and ready for racing. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-03-25

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Fail Guy vs. the V-10: Work Truck Battle
motortrend.us.description: Freiburger and Dulcich beat on David's '99 Dodge Ram and Steve's '73 Chevy. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-04-08

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - General Mayhem Returns to Its 440 Roots!
motortrend.us.description: The legendary '68 Dodge Charger General Mayhem gets stripped of its 707-hp Hellcat engine and all the related electronics; Freiburger and Dulcich vow to take it from the drag strip setup back to its motorhome 440-powered V8 and gravel-chucking roots. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-04-15

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Closer to Perfection: The '56 Chevy!
motortrend.us.description: The COVID-350-powered, six-speed 1956 Chevy Bel Air may sport 500 hp, but is far from perfection; Freiburger and Dulcich bring it closer to reaching their goals with some weight reduction, suspension modifications and a new 9-inch rear end. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-04-22

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - 1967 Cougar Die-Hard Redemption!
motortrend.us.description: Steve Dulcich enlists the help of crew member and fellow '80s action-movie enthusiast Wiley Stevens to get the '67 Bang Shifting Cougar back on the road; the guys install a new trans, suspension and custom hood, among other upgrades. (Auto, Reality) - 2022-04-29

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 1
motortrend.us.description: This year's Adventure Ride kicks off out west on the Rimrocker Trail, taking the team from Montrose, Colo. to Moab, Utah; along the way, the crew finds places to camp, while putting their rigs and overlanding skills to the test. (Reality) - 2026-10-10

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 2
motortrend.us.description: We finish the Rimrocker Trail and roll into Moab, Utah; but the adventure is just getting started as we tackle the obstacles of Behind the Rocks, then cap it all off with one of the most breathtaking trails in the country, Top of the World. (Reality) - 2026-10-17

motortrend.us.title: Truck U - Willys Pickup Kickoff
motortrend.us.description: The 1951 Willys pickup that Matt Steele got from Willie B last year is in the shop for the first time. We will build a new firewall, tear down the engine for some new upgrades, and build out the Dana 44 axles that will end up under the truck. (Auto, How-to) - 2026-06-14

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Return of the Crop Duster!
motortrend.us.description: After years of paint and body work, it's finally time to piece the Crop Duster back to life, so the guys get the engine and transmission back in the freshly painted beauty after adding some extra cubic inches. (Auto, Reality) - 2021-07-30

motortrend.us.title: Build for Off-Road - West Adventure Ride Part 3
motortrend.us.description: After coming down from the top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's trails, Hell's Revenge; with drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test. (Reality) - 2026-10-24

motortrend.us.title: Roadkill Garage - Body Swap, Street Dragging '56 Chevy!
motortrend.us.description: David and Steve nab a '56 Chevy 210 that was once an NHRA champion, but the body is complete garbage; they try to bring the car closer to its former glory, then it's off for some passes at the Kingman Street Drags on Route 66. (Auto, Reality) - 2021-05-14

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Camaros, Impalas, Goodguys, Oh My
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's buddy Tommy has a '69 Camaro that needs some love, with damaged paint on the hood and malfunctioning headlight motors; another friend, T-bone, stops by with his '65 Impala for an air ride, updated interior and repainted steering wheel. (Auto) - 2023-11-01

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - The Chupacabra Firebird
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's friend Porkchop wants to turn a '69 Firebird convertible into a tribute Trans Am for his wife; Shorty and his team transform the car with a new spoiler, motor mods with AC and fuel injection, custom interior and custom racing stripes. (Auto) - 2023-11-01

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Supercharged Nova and a 9/11 Tribute Truck
motortrend.us.description: Arturo is a good friend of the shop, and his classic Nova will be a monster, with a rebuilt supercharged 6.2 LS, plus upgrades to the chassis and brakes; the crew revives a classic 1924 LaFrance fire truck for the nearby Cedar Hill Fire Department. (Auto) - 2023-11-15

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Laid-Out Dually and Amber Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: An Amber Glow 1955 DeSoto might be pink, but it has a hemi under the hood; 2000 Chevy dually is a monster, but needs a new paint job, interior and air ride system. (Auto) - 2023-11-22

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Finishing the Ember Glow Hemi
motortrend.us.description: Shorty tries to match the Ember Glow hemi's original color, then works his magic in the paint booth; Joel tries to figure out how to install an aftermarket AC; PG works on the interior; the crew is left with an enormous amount of trim. (Auto) - 2023-11-29

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Training Day Lowrider
motortrend.us.description: A big fan of the movie "Training Day" wants his '78 Monte Carlo to be built in the same vein; the G-body needs the works, including a swapped LS, beefed-up brakes and suspension and a new interior; Shorty's G10 parts runner van needs a facelift. (Auto) - 2023-12-06

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - One-of-a-Kind Widebody
motortrend.us.description: Shorty's right-hand man in the body shop, Joe Gomez, has been in remission from cancer for nearly 10 years and wants to create a wide body Honda Accord for his wife to show his appreciation. (Auto) - 2023-12-13

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Caleb's Corvette Part 1
motortrend.us.description: After losing a grandson in a racetrack crash, Rick Wilson and his family want to raise money to promote safety at tracks around Texas; they enlist Shorty and the team to build a 1956 Corvette that will be auctioned off for their cause. (Auto) - 2023-12-20

motortrend.us.title: Shorty's Dream Shop - Caleb's Corvette Part 2
motortrend.us.description: The '56 Corvette is complete, but not without a couple of twists; the family decides to change the body color from red to arctic blue with a silver teardrop; Shorty brings in the best in the business for a lowrider paint seminar at the shop. (Auto) - 2023-12-27
