divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Patricia Nesbit vs. John Nesbit Jr.
divorcecourt.us.description: Patricia says she's had enough of her husband, John, disrespecting their marriage by sleeping with other women and his indecisiveness on whether he wants to be in a committed relationship. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-13

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Anne Pearson vs. Charles Pearson
divorcecourt.us.description: Anne suspects another woman is in the picture, which has led her to spy on Charles to catch him cheating, saying he sneaks out of the house while she is sleeping; he says she used to enjoy going out until they got married. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-14

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Niquetta Hood vs. Tyrone Johnson
divorcecourt.us.description: Niquetta tells the blatant lies from her boyfriend, Tyrone, show he's not committed to her or their family; he says he's constantly being accused of cheating and he's sick of it, so he accuses her, and asks for a DNA test for their son. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-17

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Phylicia \"Riddick\" vs. Jeremiah Koellner
divorcecourt.us.description: Phylicia says her fiancé, Jeremiah, is possessive, tracks her every move, tries to tell her how to dress, and got her fired from her job as an exotic dancer due to his jealousy. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-18

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tasha Boomer vs. Bryant Boomer
divorcecourt.us.description: Tasha is ready to end her marriage to Bryant because of his lack of motivation to find a stable job and contribute to the bills, and she is sick of him running to his family to bail him out; he says she is jealous. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-19

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nova Francis vs. Dameon Francis
divorcecourt.us.description: Nova says her husband, Dameon, is a womanizer, and she has even walked in on him with another woman; he argues that she is way too controlling. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-20

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Crystal Sanders vs. Dywan Sanders
divorcecourt.us.description: Crystal says her new husband, Dywan, lied about his financial status and is addicted to watching sports, which leaves no time for them; he says he paid his debts, and she is using past mistakes to dictate their future. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-21

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Sharkyla Truth vs. Afaria \"AJ\" Duke
divorcecourt.us.description: Sharkyla is ready to call off the wedding if her fiancé, AJ, can't stay monogamous; he admits to cheating but says he is a changed man, and the problem is Sharkyla, because she can't get past his infidelity. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-24

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Zakelia Scott vs. Michael Randle
divorcecourt.us.description: Zakelia says her boyfriend, Michael, spends all of his money on frivolous things and doesn't save any for their future; he says he is a hip-hop artist and needs the clothes and sneakers to look the part. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jaclyn Ivaniuc vs. Spencer Ruizzo
divorcecourt.us.description: Jaclyn says that during the pandemic, boyfriend Spencer started binge-eating and overspending; he says he can spend his money the way he wants to and is sick of her negative comments about his weight. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-26

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Leticia Riddle vs. Jay White
divorcecourt.us.description: Leticia believes her fiancé, Jay, is cheating with one of his exes, who lives in a home he owns; Leticia is a singer and Jay says she behaves inappropriately when she is rubbing up against other men during her shows. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-27

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Lakeysla \"Keisha\" Williams vs. Brian \"Champ\" Harmon
divorcecourt.us.description: Keisha says Champ's excessive flirting is ruining the trust in their marriage; he says that, as a rapper and television producer, it pays to have a big personality, and she needs to control her jealousy. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-28

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ieisha Shingles vs. Quan Porter
divorcecourt.us.description: Ieisha says boyfriend Quan is a serial cheater with an anger problem leading him to destroy her property on many occasions; he says she destroyed his Lakers memorabilia during an argument. (Reality, Law) - 2022-01-31

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Valerie Bossett vs. Toya Gonzales
divorcecourt.us.description: After being married less than a year, Valerie says she wants a divorce from her wife, Toya, who, she says, cheated with one of her exes; Toya says she wants to save her marriage, but Valerie holds the past against her and refuses to move forward. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jasmine Allen vs. Chance Shelton
divorcecourt.us.description: Jasmine says boyfriend Chance spends too much time at the studio and may have gotten another woman pregnant; she has invested $20,000 in his music business but hasn't seen a return; he accuses her of spending time with another man. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Brandon says his girlfriend, Nicole, is obsessed with going viral and isn't focused on her career goals; he says they are just too different, and it's best they go their separate ways. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-03

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Brandon Benson vs. Nicole Lara
divorcecourt.us.description: Nicole says she desperately wants to save her relationship with Brandon, but her goal is to go viral with her social media videos to make money. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-04

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Theresa Connors vs. Mark Haynes
divorcecourt.us.description: Theresa says her fiancé, Mark, is a sex and porn addict who spent half of their wedding budget on his addiction; he says he wants to save his relationship, but he believes she is overreacting and he doesn't have a problem. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-07

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Demetria George vs. Tyrone Faison
divorcecourt.us.description: Demetria says Tyrone wants to be in control of every aspect of her career as a stand-up comic, including who she talks to and where she performs; Tyrone says that, as the man, he wants to be respected. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-08

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - David Irvin vs. Hillary Barlow
divorcecourt.us.description: David says Hillary, his girlfriend, has a history of cheating and lying to him; she admits she was caught in some compromising situations but says she is not a cheater and that his mother is the root of all their problems. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-09

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ashlei Edwards vs. Keenann Spencer
divorcecourt.us.description: Ashley says Keenan made good money in the beginning of their relationship, then he quit his job and missed rent payments; he says she is controlling, has a military background, and tells him to do things around the house, instead of asking. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-10

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Seankeithius \"Kwaun\" Porter vs. Kamry Ukpai
divorcecourt.us.description: Kamry thinks spending all the time together is key to a successful relationship, but Kwaun says he is starting to feel smothered -- she even shows up at his workplace and refuses to leave; she says he needs to make her a priority. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-11

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Angelica Demello vs. James Maria
divorcecourt.us.description: Angelica says she cleans the house, acts as the handyman, and manages the finances, and James needs to contribute more financially and step up as the man of the house, or she will not marry him; he counters that she has a bad drinking problem. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-14

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nina Ruffini vs. Minori Hinds
divorcecourt.us.description: Nina says she is sick of her girlfriend, Minori, hiding their relationship and spending her money, and she doesn't feel appreciated; Minori says she has struggled with coming out of the closet and presses Nina to wait until she's ready. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tajanea Polk vs. Joe Cambridge
divorcecourt.us.description: Tajanea says Joe's manipulative mother, Catina, told him he needs to move on from their relationship, and she thinks Joe is seeing someone else on the side. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-16

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tajanea Polk vs. Joe Cambridge
divorcecourt.us.description: Joe says Tajanea has a history of acting erratic and paranoid when he's gone, but he wants to resolve any issues, especially the one between his girlfriend and his mother. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-17

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Chasity Evans vs. Wesley Clement
divorcecourt.us.description: Chasity says Wesley took $5,000 out of their business account to gamble; he says he doesn't have a problem, and that gambling, at times, has supported his family. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-18

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Judith Garrett vs. Andre Rodriguez
divorcecourt.us.description: Judith says Andre is a scam artist who has manipulated her into buying him a car and studio equipment and lending him thousands of dollars. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-21

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Raymond Bentley vs. Janteba Bentley
divorcecourt.us.description: Raymond says he has caught his wife, Janteba, lying about her whereabouts, found gifts from other men and caught her making dinner plans. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-22

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Angela Dewey vs. Delbert Dewey
divorcecourt.us.description: Angela says she's tired of her husband Delbert's gambling, addiction to pornography and constant cheating accusations. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-23

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Pamela Edwards vs. Lauren Edwards
divorcecourt.us.description: Pam says she has evidence proving that her wife, Lauren, has been unfaithful throughout their entire marriage. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-24

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mercedes Randall vs. Aaron Tichenor
divorcecourt.us.description: Mercedes says Aaron, a social media influencer, cares more about his persona than their six-year relationship; he says she should accept him and the benefits that come with dating a "star." (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Latina Yildiz vs. Marvin Brown
divorcecourt.us.description: Latina says Marvin has abandoned her and their family for his music career; he says it's her lack of support and respect toward him and his music that has caused a rift between them. (Reality, Law) - 2022-02-28

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Paris Parks vs. Devante McNeal
divorcecourt.us.description: Paris says Devante's lack of responsibility and concern for her well-being are driving a wedge in their 10-year relationship; he says he's tired of her shopping addiction and disrespect for him in front of their family and friends. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Terrill Jones vs. Sarah Williams
divorcecourt.us.description: Terrill says Sarah has had numerous sexual encounters with other men; she says he won't admit his past infidelities but keeps a scorecard on all her mistakes, and he tries to control everything, from what she wears to where she goes. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-02

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Trinety Mullen vs. Kentrell Warren
divorcecourt.us.description: Trinety says her husband, Kentrell, is a liar, a cheater and an alcoholic who refuses to keep a job; he argues that she constantly belittles him and accuses him of cheating when he's done nothing wrong. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-04

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Catrina Griffin vs. Keyon Bell
divorcecourt.us.description: Catrina says Keyon's paychecks don't reflect the time he claims to be working, which is why she has strong suspicions he may be living a double life, possibly even with another family. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-08

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Dianca Glamour vs. Kilo Allen
divorcecourt.us.description: Dianca suspects Kilo has started transitioning into a woman, which has changed his behavior altogether; he says he's sacrificed too much of his time, energy and money on their relationship just for Dianca to throw him away like he's worthless. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-09

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Eleazar \"Eli\" Rodriguez vs. Nohariz \"Iris\" Rodriguez
divorcecourt.us.description: Eli says his wife is a verbally abusive, freeloading alcoholic who undermines his parenting; she says she doesn't feel supported or heard in this marriage. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-11

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Arika Martin vs. Ashley Rushing
divorcecourt.us.description: From late-night calls to disappearing acts, Arika says she's reached a breaking point with her fiancée, Ashley; Ashley says she's exhausted from trying to prove that she's not spending every spare minute sneaking around behind Arika's back. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - David Fox vs. Dionne Fox
divorcecourt.us.description: David says his wife, Dionne, is emotionally and financially disrespectful, and he is certain she has physically stepped out on their marriage; Dionne says she's fed up with David's jealousy and wants him to get it under control before it's too late. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-16

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Aaliyah Hardeman vs. Robert Nellums
divorcecourt.us.description: Aaliyah says she's too good of a woman to be lied to and cheated on and wants Robert to come clean once and for all; he says she is a horrible communicator who is constantly disrespecting him. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-18

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Jade Wyatt vs. Devonta \"Deeman\" Reid
divorcecourt.us.description: Jade suspects Deeman is using his YouTube comic persona as an excuse to cheat with other women; she says his ego has taken over their relationship, and she's had enough; he says she expects him to buy her expensive gifts and be the sole provider. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-22

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Teresa Santeramo vs. Justin Wilkerson
divorcecourt.us.description: Teresa says she feels alone in her marriage because Justin is cheating on her and doesn't support her when it comes to co-parenting. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-23

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Dominique Henderson vs. Cody Campbell
divorcecourt.us.description: Dominique says she's tired of Cody allowing his family to meddle in their lives and claims she's found a video of a woman twerking and pictures of half-naked women in his phone. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-25

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Michael Taylor vs. Shanna McDaniel
divorcecourt.us.description: Rapper Michael says he's tired of Shanna constantly accusing him of cheating, her comparing him to her ex-boyfriends, and her out-of-control drinking habits; she wants him to lose the groupies and be more committed to their relationship. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-29

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Tamira Jackson vs. Steven McGaughy
divorcecourt.us.description: Tamira says she's tired of women showing up unexpectedly at her home and saying Steven fathered their children; he argues that her lack of trust and inability to support his dreams of making it in the music industry are their main problems. (Reality, Law) - 2022-03-30

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Antonett Wilson vs. Miguel Thompson
divorcecourt.us.description: Antonette says Miguel acts like he's single, pawns all their belongings, accuses her of cheating and claims their 2-year-old son isn't his child; he says he's constantly finding her talking to other men and even kissing other women. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-01

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Latosha \"Tosha\" Thomas vs. Ferdinand \"Freddy\" Thomas
divorcecourt.us.description: Tosha wants Freddy to understand the turmoil his addiction to porn causes in their relationship, and it's his refusal to be intimate with her that has caused their marriage to fall apart; he's tired of her excuses for stepping out with other men. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-05

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Ebony Strothers vs. Kenneth Walker
divorcecourt.us.description: Ebony says Kenneth tells her he is working when he is really hanging out with other women; he says he's tired of constantly trying to prove his innocence, and their relationship would thrive if she would stop snooping around. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-06

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Kayla Anderson vs. Antione Anderson
divorcecourt.us.description: Kayla says Antoine has failed to provide for their family and abandoned them multiple times; he says she needs to be more patient and stop flying off the handle every time there's a disagreement between them. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-08

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - April Walls vs. Keith Walls
divorcecourt.us.description: April says her husband, Keith, is an alcoholic who is not financially responsible and has never been honest about how he sees other women on the side; he says if she would let him be the man in their marriage, they could live a much happier life. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-12

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Mavia Clemon vs. Lenoris \"Lee\" Starks
divorcecourt.us.description: Mavia says Lee refuses to let her buy her own clothes, constantly makes her feel inferior, and must always know where she is; he says if she wants their relationship to work, she needs to be more submissive. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-13

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Janeil Munoz vs. Rico Williams
divorcecourt.us.description: Janeil says Rico is a lazy cheater who needs to either step up or leave her alone once and for all; he says she is a drama queen who's too easily influenced by outside voices and needs to stop listening to other people. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-15

divorcecourt.us.title: Divorce Court - Nicole Borden vs. Antonio Borden
divorcecourt.us.description: After 14 years, Nicole says she wants her life back: her husband, Antonio, is a serial cheater who had multiple children outside their marriage, and she no longer wishes to continue being with him. (Reality, Law) - 2022-04-19

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

retroplex.us.title: McLintock!
retroplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

retroplex.us.title: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
retroplex.us.description: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock." (Special, Documentary, Biography, Entertainment) - 2017-01-01

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Boss
retroplex.us.description: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town. (Western) - 1975

retroplex.us.title: West of the Divide
retroplex.us.description: Cowpoke Ted Hayden (John Wayne) infiltrates a band of outlaws in order to get close to their ringleader, Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock) -- the man who murdered his father. Joining Hayden on his mission is his dim but devoted companion, Dusty (George "Gabby" Hayes). But their plan gets complicated when Hayden meets Fay (Virginia Brown Faire), the lovely daughter of rancher Fred Winters (Lafe McKee). Gentry is after the man's land, and he wants Hayden to kill him to get it. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Range Beyond the Blue
retroplex.us.description: A stagecoach operator in the untamed territories of the American Southwest, Margie Rodgers (Helen Mowery) becomes a target for bandits when she starts hauling gold. Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), a pair of justice-minded cowboys, stumble across an attempt to rob one of Margie's coaches, and they save her loot from the villains. But, when it becomes clear that the attempted crime was part of a larger conspiracy, Eddie and Soapy must widen their investigation. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Frontier Fugitives
retroplex.us.description: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Ambush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Curley Thompson (Bob Steele) clashes with Hatch Bolton (I. Stanford Jolley), who is buying out small ranches in order to sell to a large grain combine. Thompson is questioned by Deputy Walter Gordon (Kermit Maynard) when Gordon's brother, the sheriff, goes missing. While investigating this disappearance, Thompson is given a cryptic clue by rancher Joe Moore (Al Ferguson), but Moore is killed before he can elaborate. Thompson and Gordon must then join forces to find the truth. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Navajo Kid
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger Tom Kirk (Bob Steele) is searching for the man who killed his adoptive father and the true identities of his biological parents. He rides into the town where the murder took place, but there Sheriff Landon (Edward Cassidy) warns him against vigilantism. This doesn't stop Tom from pursuing poker player Honest John (I. Stanford Jolley), who has the victim's ring. However, when John is shot with the same rare ammo that killed the elder Kirk, Tom realizes the murderer is still at large. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Yankee Fakir
retroplex.us.description: Yankee Davis (Douglas Fowley) and his partner, professor Newton (Ransom Sherman), are a pair of traveling hucksters on their way to a town in Arizona. Soon after they arrive, Yankee falls for a local girl, Mary Mason (Joan Woodbury). Mary's lawman father turns up dead, and Yankee is sure the man was murdered, but the death is ruled an accident. Believing something's off, Yankee has an elderly associate, Shaggy (Clem Bevans), pose as a rich man and offer a reward for clues about the killing. (Mystery) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
retroplex.us.description: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight. (Special, Performing arts) - 2007-01-30

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and the team celebrate the wonder of trees and explore the vital role they play in gardens and the wider landscape. Zoe Ball joins Toby Buckland on a visit to a tree project in North London.

700407.title: Gardeners' World

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty is preparing for spring colour as well as harvesting pumpkins and squashes. Carol Klein visits comedian Joe Lycett at home, and together, they plant up a container packed with layers of colourful bulbs. Toby Buckland visits Sue Kent's garden near Swansea to help out with autumnal maintenance.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty and team share the best practical gardening advice, meet passionate plants-people up and down the country, and provide inspiration with visits to some of the UK's most remarkable gardens.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: With spring just around the corner, Monty makes a start on his bog garden and demonstrates how to divide perennials and get plants for free. Rachel de Thame visits a garden in Kent, a labour of love where meticulous planning, discipline and precision have cleverly extended the season, and Arit Anderson plants up a seasonal container inspired by the colours of spring.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gets stuck into some seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Nick Bailey heads to Bodnant Garden in north Wales to find out how the team are tackling the recent storm damage and what new planting opportunities have been created.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty gets involved in more seasonal tasks at Longmeadow. Carol Klein celebrates the spring highlights at Beth Chatto's Gardens in Essex, and Toby Buckland is in Cornwall to meet a gardener who fell out of love with gardening.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Charlie Dimmock and the Rich brothers Harry and David, are in Hook, Hampshire to save young couple Cat and Joel from the garden from hell. These loved-up, newly weds dream of a family garden for the children that they plan to have, a space full of grass and wildlife friendly flowers, but the trouble is, all they have now is a concrete garden made up of nothing but paving stones!.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The team tackle a vertiginous three-tiered garden. This is no simple back lawn: the garden is so steep that it rises above the roof of the house to offer fantastic views of the local forest and mountain, which the owners want to take advantage of.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: The Rich brothers and Arit Anderson are on a mission to create a family garden in Horsham in Sussex for James, Charlotte and their young daughter Esmé. The trouble is, at the moment, their garden is about as exciting as a blank sheet of A4 paper.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: After an extraordinary season, Monty's orchard has a bountiful harvest of apples and he gives advice on how to pick and store them. Frances Tophill makes a final visit to her shared allotment and joins in with the festivities at their annual show. Adam Frost visits the RHS garden Wisley where he meets the Curator to discuss the effects of summer. Nick Bailey investigates knotweed, one of the most pernicious weeds in the UK, Arit Anderson provides inspiration for colourful late season containers.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: As the days get shorter, it is a busy time in the garden. Monty Don cracks on with his seasonal tasks at Longmeadow, giving hints and tips along the way. Carol Klein visits first-time gardeners Dan and Dominique for the very last time.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: In Leyton, Tariq and Sairah want to turn their dumping ground of a back yard into a sumptuous award-winning garden, suitable for entertaining friends and family. Both have competitive jobs in the banking sector and are used to winning at work but when it comes to gardening, they don't know where to begin.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: One couple battle to turn a clay-clogged building site in Sussex into a piece of Portugal. Another tackle a forest of overgrowth in their new back garden in Cadeby. They are determined to create a productive space, something they have always wanted.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: A truck driver from Wakefield with a passion for flowers wants to create a perfect outside space for his girlfriend and burgeoning family, while in Swindon a widow wants to find the best way of turning her bleak patch of green into a cottage garden.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don travels from the north west coast of Scotland to the north east coast of England, from historic reconstructions to modern re-inventions. He visits some of the most inhospitable places in the country and finds gardens that are flourishing.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across some of the country's landscapes, heading across the north of England to Northern Ireland. Here, Monty sees the ingenuity, passion and determination of British people to garden and create gardens, no matter what the canvas.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

700407.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
700407.description: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

outlaw.us.title: The Big Trees
outlaw.us.description: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone, including settler Elder Bixby; his beautiful daughter, Alicia; Fallon's fair-minded employee, Yukon Burn; and his right-hand man, Frenchy LeCroix -- and his cheating ways create unlikely bedfellows. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Hanging Tree
outlaw.us.description: Joseph "Doc" Frail (Gary Cooper) is a doctor with a past he's trying to outrun. While in Montana, he comes across a mining camp with a hanging tree and rescues a man named Rune (Ben Piazza) from the noose. With Rune as his servant, Frail decides to settle down, and he takes over as town doctor. He meets Elizabeth (Maria Schell), who is suffering from shock, and the two soon fall in love. But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her land them both in trouble. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: Springfield Rifle
outlaw.us.description: During the Civil War, Union forces stationed in Colorado are hampered by raiders who have been stealing their horses as they travel through the mountains. When several commanding officers begin to suspect a traitor is revealing troop movements, Maj. Lex Kearny (Gary Cooper) goes undercover to investigate. However, the assignment strains Kearny's relationship with his wife, Erin (Phyllis Thaxter), after he chooses to continue the operation instead of searching for their runaway son. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: South of Heaven, West of Hell
outlaw.us.description: Not only does Valentine Casey have trouble escaping his past, but also when it comes to visit him, it's usually with guns blazing. As the steadfast upholder of the law in the 1900s Arizona, Valentine leads a good life in a small town -- which unfortunately comes to a halt when his no-good family arrives and kills some innocent people. After moving to a new place and trying to restart things, pursuing a woman named Adaline along the way, his clan tracks him down again. (Western) - 2000

outlaw.us.title: 6 Bullets to Hell

outlaw.us.title: Deadman Standing

outlaw.us.title: The Fastest Guitar Alive

As the Civil War winds down, Johnny and his buddy Steve have procured a stash of gold and must now evade the prevailing Union forces. In their efforts to avoid capture, Johnny and Steve have numerous misadventures and are aided by the lovely dancing sisters Flo and Sue. (Western, Comedy) - 1967

outlaw.us.title: Bonanza - Day of Reckoning

outlaw.us.title: Kansas Pacific
outlaw.us.description: With the American Civil War looming, construction of the Pacific railroad is being held up in Kansas, sabotaged by Confederate sympathizers. The government dispatches an Army engineer, John Nelson (Sterling Hayden), to oversee construction, and he initially rubs the wrong way both his proud boss (Barton MacLane) and his boss's feisty daughter (Eve Miller). Eventually, though, both fall for Nelson's charms, and the hero seeks to uncover the Southern rat so he can lead the Union men due west. (Western) - 1953

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

However, Sebastian gets more than he bargained for as he attempts to woo Annette into his bed. (Drama) - 1999

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation

They ask John and Zack to help create a house that will embody the rustic charm they love but include some high-end gadgets.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Nation

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House Hunting
tinyhousenation.us.description: S04 E17 Tiny Together in Cleveland Anthony and Anthony are sick of living in separate pricey apartments on opposite sides of Cleveland, so they're ready to take the next step in their relationship and go tiny together.

tinyhousenation.us.title: Tiny House World

truehistory.us.title: True History
truehistory.us.description: (Special, Documentary) - 2022-01-01

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - Three Medieval Trials
truehistory.us.description: Studying three strange trials from the Middle Ages; the first involves a dead pope put on trial; the second involves an accused adulterer's walk over red-hot ploughshares. The third involves a battle whose victor is vindicated as a matter of law. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Sir Thomas More
truehistory.us.description: Traveling back to Westminster Hall on July 1, 1535, when Sir Thomas Moore stands on trial for his refusal to acknowledge King Henry VIII as head of the Church of England; one of England's most revered men ends up on the chopping block. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Giordano Bruno
truehistory.us.description: Giordano Bruno's ideas on natural philosophy are dangerous to 16th-century thought; his execution represents a failure of the Roman Inquisition to perform its mission to admonish, not punish; the impact of this trial on another heresy case. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Salem Witchcraft Trials
truehistory.us.description: According to Professor Linder, the Salem witchcraft trials illustrate the danger of drawing conclusions ahead of evidence; gaining a greater understanding of the legal basis for a travesty that accuses hundreds of people of practicing witchcraft. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Boston Massacre Trials
truehistory.us.description: A harbinger of the American Revolution, the Boston Massacre trials reflect the heated partisanship of the times; the young attorney John Adams pays a price for his decision to represent the accused British soldiers and their captain. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Aaron Burr Conspiracy Trial
truehistory.us.description: Learning whether politics and justice can be kept separate in great trials; considering the conspiracy trial of Aaron Burr presided over by Chief Justice John Marshall; no one in the United States, even the president, is above the law. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Afghanistan and the Nature of Modern War
truehistory.us.description: In the course's inaugural episode, begin to explore the transformation of violent conflicts between major world powers by delving into a particularly recent example: America's 20-year war in Afghanistan. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Nightmare Scenarios of Modern War
truehistory.us.description: The factors that explain why wars between great powers look different nowadays, and explore what future conflicts could look like between the United States and two of its major adversaries. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - The Tools of Modern Warfare
truehistory.us.description: How five contemporary technologies-the Kalashnikov assault rifle, improvised explosive devices, guided missiles, drones, and cyber warfare-redefined the rules of battle and leveled the playing field between world powers and insurgent groups. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - From World War to Cold War
truehistory.us.description: The series of events that followed World War II from the allied occupation of Germany to the Greek Civil War; how the Soviet Union contended with insurgencies and the beginnings of conflict between the United States and the USSR. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Europe's Exit from Colonial Asia
truehistory.us.description: The future of occupied Asia becomes murky after 1945; few people want to see colonial occupiers reassert their influence; zeroing in on conflicts in Indonesia, the Philippines and India to see how geopolitics in the region transform after the war. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - China's Civil War
truehistory.us.description: As war rages on across the globe, China has to contend with civil war; exploring the war from its colonial roots to the establishment of the People's Republic of China; how the U.S.S.R. and the United States get involved in the conflict. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - The Unfinished Korean War
truehistory.us.description: Why America fights a war in Korea; how the U.S.S.R. engages in the conflict; whether the United States could wage a limited war on the peninsula as it intends to; what to make of a war that ends not in peace, but in an armistice. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: War in the Modern World - Britain's Exit from Palestine, Malaya, and Kenya
truehistory.us.description: After World War II, organized rebellions explode within the British Empire; investigating the conflicts that shake postwar Palestine, Kenya and Malaya; British counterinsurgency tactics; what these confrontations reveal about war and colonialism. (History, World history) - 2022-10-12

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Socrates
truehistory.us.description: Surveying some of history's greatest trials with a visit to ancient Athens; in 399 B.C., Socrates undergoes his trial for corrupting Athenians and disrespecting their gods; In the process, he lectures his jurors on the duty of seeking the truth. (World history) - 2017-12-08

truehistory.us.title: The Great Trials of World History and the Lessons They Teach Us - The Trial of Gaius Verres
truehistory.us.description: To save the Roman Republic, Cicero charges Gaius Verres, a provincial governor, with crimes against the people; Cicero's Actio Secunda aims to educate the Roman public about the corruption and rot in its political system. (World history) - 2017-12-08

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1984, south Miami became the home for a sadistic serial killer. Posing as a fashion photographer, Christopher Wilder lured young women from shopping malls with promises of fame and fortune. Most ended up dead. As the FBI closed in around him, Wilder took off on a cross-country murderous rampage. The FBI added Wilder to their Most Wanted Fugitives program. The chase was on, and Wilder ultimately lost.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Larry Horn nearly got away with the perfect crime: a multiple murder-for-hire plot that was meticulously planned and executed. Horn's former wife, their 8-year-old son, and a live-in nurse were all brutally murdered by an assassin. In the absence of any significant clues, police in Maryland contacted the FBI to assist in the investigation.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A cunning predator was loose in rural South Carolinaabducting young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was also a sadist, calling one victim's family, taunting them, boosting and then dashing their hopes. Local investigators called on the FBI to help them find this clever serial killer. Like a game of chess, FBI profilers and forensic examiners were able to outwit the killer, and put an end to his deadly game of cat and mouse.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a young boy and his mother were kidnapped and murdered by a vicious drug cartel, FBI agents in the field worked tirelessly to pierce the secretive drug underworld and unearth those involved. Their surveillance and investigative work uncovered a violent trail of murder and greed. FBI agents and forensic examiners pieced together the evidence needed to draw out and then crush the cartel.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Local law enforcement became stumped when the body of an unidentified young woman turned up on a highway in their small Pennsylvania town. They turned to the FBI labs. The hi-tech lab enabled investigators and agents to identify the victim. Knowing who she was allowed agents to reconstruct her every move. Though the road to finding her killer was twisted and long, agents persisted.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A serial killer's rampage was discovered when the bodies of several young women began turning up in shallow graves that dotted the Alaskan wilderness. The killer taunted his victims, hunting them like animals before shooting them down. He was at home in the rugged terrain. But the hunt for him began 3000 miles away, where FBI profilers mapped the criminal's mind.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a judge and his politician wife were brutally murdered in their home. The killer left few clues and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI was patiently waiting in the wings. Once it was determined that federal laws had been violated, they pounced on the investigation. They uncovered a corrupt local government and a group of violent criminal conspirators known as the Dixie Mafia, responsible for fraud, money laundering and murder.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's. Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Residents of the small town of Noel, Missouri were shocked when one of their banks was robbed. When the bank president was nowhere to be found, the residents were outraged. The FBI discovered that things are not always as they appear. Minute clues led the agents to the body of the bank president. With no suspects, the FBI relied on dogged determination and modern forensics. Agents slowly pieced together tiny shreds of evidence.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: From May until July of 1984, Alton Coleman and his common law wife, Denise Brown, engaged in a gruesome crime spree that spanned six states and left eight people dead including children. The FBI coordinated law enforcement efforts throughout the entire country in order to track the couple. Their expertise in conducting manhunts for the nation's most horrible killers paid off. The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In 1980, the FBI began a massive undercover operation, code named Safebet, that was designed to expose the Chicago Mafia's infiltration into the city's surrounding suburbs. Undercover agents quickly discovered that the mob had its tentacles spread into every facet of the law enforcement community. They unwittingly uncovered the murder of a wealthy socialite perpetrated by a jealous and greedy mob lawyer and covered up by the local police chief.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation. With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators. On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies. They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car. What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Beginning in summer of 1990, the bodies of several women began turning up in and around the city of Vienna, Austria. From an extensive investigation by the Viennese police, it was determined that these murders were the work of one sadistic predator. Europe was dealing with a serial killer. With no experience with this kind of predator, Viennese police turned to the FBI. FBI profilers were able to identify a suspect in the murders. More ominously, they linked this same killer to murders committed in the United States.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On August 20, 1980, an unseen sniper murdered two young black men as they jogged with two white women in Salt Lake City, Utah. Police threw all their resources into finding a killer who left almost no clues behind. They met with FBI agents and detectives from around the country who had similar racially motivated sniper slayings. A month later, working off little more than a possible license plate number, police in Kentucky arrested Joseph Paul Franklin but the man escaped from custody.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: By April of 1995 in Washington, D.C., two officers had been shot and one had been murdered. Each had been sitting in their patrol cars when a man sneaked up and opened fire. The FBI was brought in to help catch the cop killer. Agents identified the man who was most likely the killer, but he was nowhere to be found. Months of surveillance operations around the country finally yielded a break; they found their suspect in Baltimore, MD.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Racial tensions in Buffalo in 1980 were at an all-time high. Six black males had been brutally murdered--two had their hearts cut out. The only thing connecting the victims was their ethnicity and the fact that each had been shot with .22 caliber bullets. Residents screamed for the police to stop this serial killer. With no suspects, local investigators turned to the FBI. Profilers were able to produce a psychological composite of the type of person the killer would most likely be. Their analysis paid off.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When a Delaware woman vanished in 1996, family and friends discovered her secret life. The appointments secretary to the Governor had carried on an illicit affair with a wealthy married man. Agents suspected that her powerful ex-lover was responsible, but they had little physical evidence to support their theory. Investigators never found the woman's body or the murder weapon. The FBI's only hope was to go undercover, and turn brother against brother.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In the early 90s, Washington, D.C. police were losing the battle against street gangs who enforced their territories with lethal violence. The homicide rate in the nation's capital climbed to the highest in the country. Local police turned to the FBI for help, but agents soon found themselves in the direct line of fire. In the fall of 1994, a gang member walked into police headquarters, killed two FBI agents and one detective, then turned the gun on himself.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: In June of 1992, masked bandits pulled off a daring mid-day bank robbery. It marked the beginning of a four-year crime wave that rocked Seattle. With each new robbery, the bandits perfected their craft, leaving behind no evidence and escaping with hundreds and thousands of dollars. As the robbers became increasingly violent, pressure mounted to end their reign. With few leads, the FBI forced their own luck. The effort put them face to face with an armed and desperate fugitive.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When police in a small Washington State community began looking into the disappearance of a 22-year-old woman, they had no way of knowing it would evolve into a nationwide hunt for a sexual sadist. Police knew the killer's identity, but he was a master of disguise. The FBI was called on to help. Agents discovered that several unsuspecting women across the northwest had fallen prey to his charms.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A stranger snatched an eight-year-old girl as she played in her Tucson, Arizona neighborhood, leaving behind an abandoned bicycle and a frantic mother. Hundreds of citizens and police officers fanned out across the region, hoping to find some trace of the young girl or her abductor. Within hours, a suspect emerged; a drifter who was out on parole for abducting and molesting children. He was nowhere to be found and time had run out for the innocent child.

673498.title: Jubal
673498.description: Searching for work, cowboy Jubal Troop (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small town, where he badly injures his hand. Fortunately, a local rancher, Shep Horgan (Ernest Borgnine), is willing to employ Troop despite the injury. Horgan and Troop work together amicably, but Horgan's two-timing wife (Valerie French) threatens to create discord when she becomes interested in Troop, although he really loves another woman. A jealous cowhand (Rod Steiger) complicates matters by spreading lies.

673498.title: Dirty Little Billy
673498.description: After his family moves to a frontier town in Kansas, city-bred teenager Billy Bonney (Michael J. Pollard) finds he has no appetite for farming. He runs away, taking up with local outlaw Goldie (Richard Evans), who operates a saloon in town with the help of a prostitute named Berle (Lee Purcell). The three form a gang of sorts, menacing the locals until the townsfolk collectively decide to drive the outlaws away. Bonney escapes and begins the life of crime that makes him famous as Billy the Kid.

673498.title: Cripple Creek
673498.description: A federal agent (George Montgomery) and two colleagues infiltrate a gang of gold-rush gold smugglers.

673498.title: The Thrill Hunter
673498.description: After lying about being a stuntman, a blowhard (Buck Jones) gets the chance to prove himself to a movie studio.

673498.title: Brave Warrior
673498.description: Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

673498.title: Major Dundee
673498.description: During the end of the Civil War, Major Dundee guards Confederate prisoners, Union deserters and ordinary hard-bitten criminals in a remote fort. When Apaches attack the fort and make off with three children, Dundee must set up a posse including Confederates, who face a choice between joining up or being shot. The feud between Dundee and Tyreen is also heated up by a sultry Mexican widow.

673498.title: Western Code
673498.description: Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.

673498.title: Gun Fury
673498.description: California-bound rancher Ben Warren (Rock Hudson) is shot and left for dead when a demented ex-Confederate, Frank Slayton (Phil Carey), kidnaps his Southern bride-to-be (Donna Reed). Revived, Ben sets out to rescue her. Along the way, he picks up Jess Burgess (Leo Gordon), a slighted former member of Slayton's gang, and American Indian local Johash (Pat Hogan), who has his own beef with the outlaws. Together they embark on a perilous chase toward the Mexican border to stop Slayton.

673498.title: Fighting Fool
673498.description: A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.

673498.title: The Longest Drive
673498.description: After a decade apart, a pair of brothers reunites to find their long-lost sister, who was kidnapped as a child and is now living with a native tribe.

673498.title: Apache Territory
673498.description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

673498.title: Riding Wild
673498.description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

673498.title: They Rode West
673498.description: Dr. Allen Seward (Robert Francis) is the new doctor at a remote Army outpost. His liberal attitudes towards Native Americans become a source of tension between him and his superiors, especially Capt. Peter Blake (Philip Carey), who regards all Native Americans as dangerous and untrustworthy. Seward's insistence on treating several local Kiowa tribespeople for malaria further enrages Blake, who deems Seward a traitor when the Kiowa join forces with the Comanches and attack the fort.

673500.title: The Caine Mutiny
673500.description: During World War II, a dilapidated vessel, the Caine, gets a new ensign, Willis Keith (Robert Francis), and a new captain, Commander Queeg (Humphrey Bogart). The crew sees Queeg's unconventional behavior as irrational, and communications officer Thomas Keefer (Fred MacMurray) spreads suspicion about his suitability as captain. When a dire situation during a storm forces the executive officer (Van Johnson) to relieve Queeg of his duties, he and Ensign Keith are tried for mutiny.

673500.title: Ten Cents a Dance
673500.description: Barbara O'Neill (Barbara Stanwyck) is a poor dance hall girl who catches the eye of the wealthy Bradley Carlton (Ricardo Cortez). However, Barbara has feelings for her neighbor Eddie Miller (Monroe Owsley). After Eddie proposes to her, she says yes, and even secures a job for him from Bradley. Soon, though, Eddie has racked up deep gambling debts and even been unfaithful. Barbara continues to support him, but after he lashes out in jealousy she thinks maybe she should have chosen Bradley.

673500.title: American Madness
673500.description: During the Depression, the bank owned by generous Dickson (Walter Huston) is barely staying afloat, and things get worse when $100,000 is lifted from the vault. Fingers are pointed at reformed crook Matt (Pat O'Brien), who got a job and a fresh start from Dickson. The innocent Matt can clear his name by admitting that on the night of the robbery he was breaking up a tryst between Dickson's wife and another teller. But this revelation may crush Dickson, and Matt's conscience plays tug-of-war.

673500.title: The Collector
673500.description: A meek bank clerk and butterfly collector becomes increasingly obsessed with an art student who he’s determined to make fall in love with him.

673500.title: Autumn Leaves
673500.description: An aging, lonely spinster marries a good-looking younger man only to find that he has a very tormented past and is mentally disturbed.

673500.title: Bonjour tristesse
673500.description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

673500.title: The Key
673500.description: In World War II England, a reclusive landlady has a series of relationships with tugboat captains who have each inherited the key to her apartment.

673500.title: Cactus Flower
673500.description: A dentist pretends he's married to avoid committing to his girlfriend. When she asks to meet his wife, he enlists his nurse to pose as his spouse.

673500.title: A Raisin in the Sun
673500.description: Sidney Poitier stars in this iconic version of the famous play about a cash poor family who start to fray when they inherit a life insurance payout.

As he fades away, Marik appears to an unconscious Odion, thanks him for taking care of him and apologizes, wishing that he could take back his cruel actions. 724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The first railroad train is coming to the new North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman and his servant, visiting the West to learn about the United States.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm. Lucas' life is endangered when a snake crawls into his bed.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a good friend from Lucas' past. But it's pleasure before business. Mario has been hired to kill Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town. The family patriarch becomes marshal and deputizes his sons.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a pretty young stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's two older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight them both.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Young Dan Willard takes on Marshal Micah Torrence's job. With no experience, he takes a tough stand with a bunch of Texas cowhands whose high spirits are evident at the saloon.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas gets in trouble when he accuses the foreman of a neighboring ranch of rustling some of his cattle.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark are returning from a big cattle sale when the stage is robbed by three outlaws. Lucas, desperate to recover the money that was stolen, is determined to pursue the outlaws.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An Argentine family moves to North Fork. The townspeople are unfriendly to them, making fun of their clothing and customs. The Argentinean adult immigrant is openly hostile in return.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas and Mark find themselves exposed to anthrax after they adopt a stray horse whose owner has been killed in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: After the end of the Civil War, General Phil Sheridan, who has been appointed Governor of the New Mexico Territory, is on an inspection tour of the country.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: A famous gunfighter marries and decides to retire. He and his wife settle down in North Fork and open a store, but three outlaws arrive in town looking to best him in a gunfight.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: An old friend of Lucas McCain's, a traveling photographer, comes to North Fork plying his trade. When a murder is committed, the photographer is accused of the crime.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: The townsfolk of North Fork decide to give a young couple a shivaree celebration. When the drunken crowd gets out of hand and roughs up the bride-to-be, the young groom challenges them.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: When a young boy from Brooklyn is accused of murder, Mark, believing the boy's claim of innocence, hides him until he can find the real killer.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: U.S. Marshal Sam Buckhart arrives in North Fork in search of renegade Indians suspected of the brutal killing of a Texas Ranger and his family.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Sid Fallon tries to blackmail former gambler Julia Andueza into allowing him to use her boarding house as a gambling hall and saloon.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas puts his life in jeopardy when he agrees to testify in a murder case where the first witness was killed before he could testify, and the killer is still at large.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Outlaw Sam Morley falls in love with a young woman who has a serious illness and asks Lucas to turn him in for the reward and use the money to pay for her medical care.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas welcomes his old friend Tom Birch, who once saved his life, unaware that the man is now a bank robber on the run with his gang.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Dan Maury, released from Yuma prison, arrives in North Fork intent on getting even with Marshal Torrance, who helped send him to jail.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Young Mark McCain is eager to help lawman Jay Jefferson, who has arrived in North Fork intent on killing an outlaw for the reward, whether he is the right man or not.

724210.title: The Rifleman
724210.description: Lucas comes to the rescue when escaped convicts hold up the general store in North Fork and take Marshall Torrance hostage.

itvmeridian.uk.title: Nations Championship - Northern Series: England v Japan

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Bridge On The River Kwai
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: A highly principled British colonel becomes obsessed with leading a band of P.O.W.s to build a bridge at the behest of their Japanese captors in World War II Burma.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: King Of My Castle

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Legend of Fong Sai-Yuk

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Emu Runner

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Comic
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: The story of a brilliant silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Long Live Robin Hood

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: We Were Soldiers

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Vera And The Pleasure Of Others
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: In between school and volleyball classes, Vera rents out an empty flat to teenagers looking for a place to have sex. Way to make money develops into Vera's discovery of her own sexual desires.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: How To Get Ahead In Advertising
